territorial_scope.description: Applies to elections and plebiscites governed by Chilean electoral laws listed in Art. 2.

evidence.quote: Las disposiciones de esta ley se aplicarán a las elecciones y plebiscitos regidos por la Ley N° 18.700

summary.short: Chilean bill (Boletín 18669-06) that would ban coordinated automated-account networks for electoral propaganda, require labelling of AI-generated electoral content, prohibit deceptive synthetic depictions of persons, require declarations and record-keeping, and impose fines and disqualification.
summary.long: The bill would apply to elections and plebiscites governed by Chilean electoral laws (Art. 2). It defines automated accounts, coordinated non-authentic behaviour and synthetic content (Art. 3). Art. 4 prohibits commissioning, contracting, financing or operating, directly or through third parties, a set of automated accounts to make electoral propaganda, excluding coordinated diffusion by unpaid volunteers. Art. 5 requires digital propaganda providers to file a sworn declaration at contracting, sent with the campaign's accounts to the electoral administrator. Art. 6 requires candidates, parties, electoral pacts and plebiscite sponsors to declare to the Servicio Electoral digital positioning contracts made within twelve months before the election. Art. 7 requires electoral propaganda that is synthetic to carry the label "Contenido generado o alterado con inteligencia artificial" and the sender's name. Art. 8 prohibits commissioning, contracting or disseminating synthetic content that invents or alters the actions, image or voice of a living, deceased or fictional person in a way a reasonable person could take as authentic. Art. 9 requires a public record of synthetic products in electoral expense reports. Art. 10 sets municipal-benefit fines of 30 to 300 monthly tax units for breaches of Arts. 4 and 8, fiscal fines of 10 to 100 monthly tax units for false declarations, without prejudice to criminal liability, and disqualification of providers from the next two electoral processes. The text states no entry-into-force date.},

notes: Target IDs are not in the registry, so target_instrument_id is empty. The Fundamentos cite Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, Reg. 2024/900 and Brazil's TSE Resolution 23.732/2024 as comparative background only; they are not coded as relations. Internal inconsistency: Art. 3(b) defines 'comportamiento coordinado no auténtico' by reference to influencing an electoral outcome, while Art. 4, whose title uses that term, prohibits operating automated accounts for 'propaganda electoral'. The text numbers Art. 8 as 'Artículo 8-'.

thresholds.variable_text: contratos de servicios de posicionamiento digital celebrados dentro de los doce meses anteriores a la fecha de la elección respectiva
thresholds.value_text: dentro de los doce meses anteriores a la fecha de la elección respectiva
thresholds.measurement: Look-back window measured from the date of the relevant election (or plebiscite) to the contract date; declaration made at candidate or party registration (al momento de su inscripción) before the Servicio Electoral
thresholds.consequence: Digital positioning service contracts made within this window must be declared to the Servicio Electoral at registration.
thresholds.conditions: Applies to candidates, parties, electoral pacts and plebiscite option holders, whether the contract was entered by them or by third parties; the declaration applies regardless of how much of the spending is attributable to the campaign period.

evidence.quote: dentro de los doce meses anteriores a la fecha de la elección respectiva, con independencia del gasto imputable al periodo de campaña electoral
